$comment: The sha256 of each ZIPP release's SHA256SUMS, recorded when this repository adopted the release. fetch-zipp-release.mjs refuses a SHA256SUMS for a listed release with any other digest, wherever it was fetched from; scripts/checks/engine-pin.test.mjs requires the declared release (the zipp-vm tag in apps/softn-host-rust/Cargo.toml) to be listed, with the digest the installed engine was verified against. Add a release's digest when moving to it: node packages/@softn/core/scripts/fetch-zipp-release.mjs --resolve-only vX.Y.Z prints it.
